summary: The paper discusses the thermodynamic inconsistencies in fractional exclusion statistics (FES) when mutual exclusion statistics parameters are non-zero. It introduces new parameters proportional to the dimension of the subspace on which they act to resolve these inconsistencies and ensures consistent thermodynamic results. The study focuses on the behavior of particle distributions and the conditions under which thermodynamic limits are valid.
